beginner.title: Get started with Onfleet
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Onfleet, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Navigate the system
beginner.outcome: You can: find, create and update records
beginner.practice: Create and update one record end to end

beginner.title: Core workflow
beginner.outcome: You can: complete your role's main workflow
beginner.practice: Complete one full workflow for your role

intermediate.title: Planning and scheduling
intermediate.outcome: You can: plan work, stock or projects
intermediate.practice: Build a plan or schedule for a real piece of work

intermediate.title: Reports and dashboards
intermediate.practice: Build a report your manager asks for

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Onfleet
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Onfleet distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Onfleet
expert.outcome: You can: use Onfleet's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Configure and integrate
expert.outcome: You can: adapt Onfleet to how your organisation works
expert.practice: Propose and test one configuration improvement

expert.title: Integrate Onfleet into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Onfleet with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Onfleet to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Onfleet well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Onfleet" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
